Subject: Onboarding office hours — Redwood trial (SDK & API key setup)

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for signing up for the Redwood trial. I booked a 30-minute office-hours slot so we can walk through API key provisioning, SDK initialization, and a quick integration check:

When: Thu, May 13 · 10:00–10:30 AM PT
Where: Zoom (link in calendar invite)

Agenda (quick):
- Confirm API key and scopes
- SDK install + sample generate call
- Troubleshoot any error you see (0–30 min)

I added Monica (solutions support) and Stephanie (integration engineer) to the invite in case we need to dig into logs or adjust firewall rules. If that time doesn't work, reply with 2 alternatives and I'll reschedule.

I attached a short quickstart PDF with the exact curl + Python snippets to save time.

Looking forward to it —
Dylan

Attachments: redwood_sdk_quickstart.pdf
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@greentree.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-13T10:35:00-07:00
Subject: Missed office hours — quick follow-up and next steps

Hi Sara —

We were in the office-hours slot starting at 10:00 and didn't see anyone join. No worries — things come up. I left the Zoom open until 10:25 in case you tried to jump in.

Quick checklist in case you want to self-troubleshoot before we rebook:
- Confirm you created an API key under Settings -> API Keys in the Console (scope: trial.read, trial.generate).
- If you're behind a corporate proxy, allow outbound to api.redwoodinference.com:443.
- If you get a 403, double-check the key hasn't been rotated.

If you'd like to reschedule, I'm free Friday morning (May 14) 9–11 AM PT and Monday 10–12 PM PT. Otherwise tell me 2 times that work and we'll lock something in.

If you prefer, I can also share a short recording of the steps and an annotated SDK snippet.

Thanks —
Dylan
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@greentree.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-13T14:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Missed office hours — quick follow-up and next steps

Hi Dylan —

Sorry about the miss. We had an unexpected all-hands that ran over and I couldn't step out. I appreciate you waiting.

Friday morning (May 14) at 9:30 AM PT works for me. A couple of quick questions so we can make the most of the slot:
1) Are trial API keys scoped to a single developer email or the org? We plan to provision CI/CD runners that call the API.
2) We're evaluating on-prem later in the quarter. Will the SDK calls/auth flow differ materially for Private deployments?

If you can confirm, I’ll add our dev alias (dev@greentree.ai) to the invite so others can join.

Thanks —
Sara
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@greentree.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Missed office hours — quick follow-up and next steps

Perfect — 9:30 AM PT on Fri, May 14 is confirmed. I resent the calendar invite and added dev@greentree.ai per your note.

Answers to your two questions up front:
- Trial API keys are org-scoped but can be limited by role/scopes. For CI/CD, we recommend creating a machine key with only the generate scope and rotating it periodically. We'll show how to do this during the call.
- SDK/auth for Private (on-prem/VPC) is the same code surface; the difference is endpoint and auth broker configuration (we'll share the sample config for your infra team).

Below is the minimal Python snippet we’ll run together — you can paste your key into REDWOOD_API_KEY and replace model with the trial variant: 

# Python SDK init (snippet)
import redwood
client = redwood.Client(api_key="REDWOOD_API_KEY")
resp = client.generate(model="redwood-trial-v1", prompt="Hello world")
print(resp.text)

If you hit a 403, paste the exact error and Monica will jump on a quick diagnostic. Stephanie, can you pre-check the GreenTree dev alias and firewall notes so we avoid connection issues?

Attachments: GreenTree-MAP.docx (mutual action plan for the trial)

See you shortly —
Dylan
